verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing page or per-seat tier prices. It only mentions in passing a "generous free tier" and that a HIPAA BAA is available on organization/enterprise plans. A community comment cites a $29/month premium username, which is an add-on price, not per-seat tier pricing. Nothing shows what each tier costs per seat or includes, so the founder could not evaluate tiers before talking to sales.
